page.title: See ReelBolt at work before you sign up
page.lead: No footage and no editor yet? This is the ReelBolt launch film. It shows the product doing the work.

film.caption: The film is in English and plays without sound until you turn it on. It runs about a minute.
film.unavailable: The example film is not available right now. Come back soon, or read what ReelBolt does on the features page.

inside.title: What the film shows
inside.intro: The film opens on a founder at a desk at night, asking an AI assistant for a launch video. It then shows what happened next, in the product itself:
items: The assistant's requests running, each one allowed before it starts.
The editing room working through the steps of the film.
The takes and a real timeline you can open and change.
The picture editor and the logo.
inside.note: This is one film made by the team behind ReelBolt, not a customer's result.

next.title: Make your own
next.body: You can bring your product, your footage and your brand. If you have no footage yet, you can start from your product alone.
